bio: What is it that draws legions of visitors from near and far to this tranquil village in Markgräflerland? Douce Steiner and Udo Weiler's hotel-restaurant is housed in a picture-perfect building that dates back over 500 years. It boasts a charming, elegant dining area and friendly, attentive service. Windows allow a glimpse into the kitchen, where the chefs create a five- to seven-course set menu that takes its cue from the seasons. In doing so, they draw on classic French influences and use regional produce wherever possible. Ultra-fresh langoustine royale, for example, is elevated by the subtle contrasts provided by a combination of red Kampot pepper, pink grapefruit, olive oil and basil.
